item.title: 50/50 Bachata & Salsa on Thursdays — Thu Sep 17, 7:00 PM — Neruda’s Brunswick
item.description:
Spring has sprung! Let’s dance! Showy Dance Melbourne & Neruda Brunswick joined forces to bring a night for Bachata & Salsa class + a Social dance night! Every Thursday from 7 pm. 7 pm: Bachata class. 8 pm: Salsa class. 9 pm: Social night. After the 2 classes finished, we will continue the night with Social dance. Neruda Brunswick is a Latino American restaurant located in Brunswick. Address: 66 Breese St, Brunswick. Both of our classes will be Open level. Cost of the class: 1 class $20.- 2 classes $30.- After the classes you can stay for the Social night to practice the steps that you learnt in class or just mingle enjoying the vibes and the Latin atmosphere of Neruda Brunswick. Any question: Just give us a call: 0431 037 786. email: showydancemelbourne@gmail.com See you on the dance floor!! …….
Source: Go Latin Dance

item.title: Pontoon Salsa Thursdays — Thu Sep 17, 7:30 PM — Pontoon Bar Darling Harbour
item.description: Welcome to Pontoon Salsa Thursdays! Get ready to spice up your Thursday nights with the hottest Latin dance party in town! Join us every Thursday at Pontoon Bar for a dancer’s dream evening filled with Salsa, Bachata, and good vibes. ✨ What to Expect: Join us at 7:30pm for FREE Intermediate to Advanced level Salsa + Bachata Lesson! Experience required. Drink Specials: $7.50 Coronas and $25 Sangria jugs to share with friends! $10 Pizzas: Refuel with mouthwatering pizzas to keep you energised all night. Music rotation: 2 x Salsa, 2 x Bachata, and 1 x Latino anthem. Curated Music: Our DJs will keep the dance floor moving with specially selected Salsa and Bachata for dancers. Pontoon Bar offers stunning harbor views, a vibrant atmosphere, and friendly staff to ensure you have an unforgettable experience. This event is for anyone who loves Latin music and dance, whether you’re a seasoned pro or just looking to have fun and meet new people. Celebrating a special occasion? We’ve got you cover

item.title: Salsa & Bachata Classes - Intermediate/ Advanced — Thu Sep 17, 7:40 AM — Dance With Me NYC – SoHo
item.description:
Take your Salsa and Bachata skills to the next level! This intermediate class focuses on more complex patterns, turns, and musicality to help you dance with greater style and confidence. Perfect for dancers who know the basics and are ready to challenge themselves, refine their technique, and add flair to their social dancing. No partner needed—just bring your energy and get ready to move!
Source: Go Latin Dance

item.title: Anua — Thu Sep 17, 8:30 AM — Foodie Aisle
item.description:
Anua is popping up at Union Station to celebrate the launch of its newest VITA C skincare lineup! Stop by the Foodie Aisle to explore the new products, learn more about Anua and its approach to skincare, and discover how VITA C can fit into your daily routine.
Guests will have the opportunity to interact with the products, learn more about the ingredients and benefits behind the new collection, and receive complimentary Anua samples while supplies last.
Whether you’re already an Anua fan or discovering the brand for the first time, come by, experience the new VITA C lineup, and find your newest skincare essential.
Wednesday, September 16th: 10am – 7pm
Thursday, September 17th: 8am – 7pm
Free to attend. Samples available while supplies last.
Source: Union Station Toronto

item.title: Salsa Thursdays at Time Out Market — Thu Sep 17, 7:00 PM — Time Out Market New York
item.description:
Join us for one of NYC’s best free salsa nights and turn your Thursday into a dance-floor celebration.
Get your salsa on every Thursday night at Time Out Market New York! Head up to the fifth floor for an electrifying evening of rhythm, movement, and Latin vibes. Whether you’re a total beginner or a seasoned dancer, this is your weekly excuse to move, sweat, and smile. Starting at 7:30 PM, renowned instructor Marlene Veras will guide you through the steps, breaking down the fundamentals so you feel confident on the dance floor. The night is powered by infectious beats from DJ Ray Suave, with live percussion by Jessica La Timbalera, setting the stage for a high-energy salsa experience. After the lesson, the floor opens up for a full-on salsa dance party until 10 PM. Bring a partner or come solo—everyone’s welcome.
Source: Go Latin Dance

item.description:
